separate_proposed_distributor_identity_s.semantics: Only lexical link text or complete regular DATA; never source as shell, auto-follow, or fallback. Not added to the three-leaf collector; separate explicit selection required before collection.

exact_member_queries.required_prior_evidence: Root reception of actual terminal DATA body pin; parent reports observed size, not accepted here.

exact_requested_data_roles: Member-scoped ownership/distributor record for each selected path and complete binary SHA256; not a global package listing.
Matched publisher binary member bytes plus complete archive/index/checksum/signature provenance for its exact architecture/version/build.
Corresponding distributor source package and applied patches/build configuration, not only an upstream tag or embedded version.
Matched generated trusted-dirs.h and architecture/cache-flag/OS compatibility rules for the received loader.
Matched debug/link-map or bounded relocation-symbol records mapping the existing 18 initialization/finalization origins to named CRT/application routines.
Only the concrete referenced option/help/version/initialization/diagnostic/exit/helper source spans and justified locale/configuration/extra-load/child branches.

provider_selection.rule: Resolve from matching received distributor/member evidence before any fetch; no guessed distro/version/archive basename, directory listing or automatic recursive retrieval. Existing matching receipts may replace duplicate collection. Package/source evidence is requested as data only; no package-manager invocation, remote contact or download is submitted by this proposal.

stage_order: Receive the exact one-leaf identity source/request; a separate root grant is required for any collection.
Receive full identity DATA without executing its contents; an alias only supplies link text and stops, without fallback.
Using identity and root-accepted seven body roles, name at most seven exact member ownership/distributor records and exact package/archive/index artifacts for a separate finite operation request.
Receive whole matched binary member bytes and authenticated artifact linkage to exact distributor source/patch/build records.
Map accepted 18 initializer origins and subsequently accepted kpathsea origins to exact source/debug/address spans and classify only relevant helper/configuration/locale/load/child/exit branches.
